responsibility: This Python checker validates Meta-format string usage inside GNU Modula-2 source and grammar files, specifically .mod and .bnf inputs. It walks a source directory, locates lines associated with Meta calls, extracts quoted string fragments and embedded brace-delimited placeholders, and reports simple formatting mistakes such as misplaced positional digits in percent-style specifiers. Its output is diagnostic-only, setting a nonzero exit status for malformed meta message templates rather than transforming files.
